title: Th' Almighty Reigns Exalted High
description: Th' Almighty Reigns Exalted High in Tonic Solfa to WINCHESTER NEW, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for The Psalms of David Imitated in the Language of the New Testament (1719): Psalm 97, part 3, headed “Grace and glory”.
Watts' psalms were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Long Metre (8.8.8.8). This page sets the words to WINCHESTER NEW; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Th'Al-migh-ty reigns ex-alt-ed high O'er all the earth, o'er all the sky, Tho' clouds and dark-ness veil his feet, His dwell-ing is the mer-cy seat.

lines: O'er all the earth, o'er all the sky,
Tho' clouds and darkness veil his feet,
O ye that love his holy Name,
Hate every work of sin and shame;
He guards the souls of all his friends,
And from the snares of hell defends.
Are for the saints in darkness sown;
Those glorious seeds shall spring and rise,
And the bright harvest bless our eyes.
The sacred honours of the Lord;
None but the soul that feels his grace

source: Isaac Watts, The Psalms of David Imitated (1719)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to WINCHESTER NEW by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
